acceptanceCriteria: One authoritative queue replaces stale or duplicate execution status.
Every indexed spec and shipped command maps to a current disposition without implying completion.
Broken roadmap references are repaired or removed and the human-owned source remains identifiable.
body: Reconcile ROADMAP, integrated plans, spec index, implementation, release evidence and pending memory. This is a status audit and repair, not capability promotion.
title: Reconcile live portfolio into one authoritative v1 queue
